acceptanceCriteria: The spec row cites the actual line of the no-suites-collected site.

body: Reported by the V1-1919 lane (PR #1201): docs/specs/js-live-test-provider-v0.md cites internal/jstestprovider/playwright.go:91 for the `no-suites-collected` reason, but the code site is around line 137; it was already stale at base 714393264. line-citations-check did not catch it, so the citation is either not a checked declaration or the check does not cover this table.
title: js-live-test-provider-v0 cites playwright.go:91 for no-suites-collected; the site is near line 137
